subject: Creativity
title: AI and the Future of Creative Work: Threat or Toolkit?
description: A short lesson to help you apply AI and the Future of Creative Work: Threat or Toolkit?.

hook.text: AI can now write code, compose music, generate images, and draft articles.

buildup.text: Generative AI automates the execution layer of creative work — first drafts, rough layouts, and variations.

discovery.text: What AI can't do yet: understand cultural context, feel empathy, make taste judgments, or create with intention.

twist.text: History suggests AI will do to creative work what ATMs did to banking: eliminate routine tasks while increasing demand.

climax.text: The creators who thrive will be 'centaurs' — human-AI hybrids using AI for speed while providing taste and direction.

punchline.text: AI won't replace creators. It will replace creators who don't use AI.
